# Governor General's Innovation Awards

> The Governor General's Innovation Awards celebrates and recognizes exceptional Canadian innovation across diverse sectors and industries.

This site provides information about Canada's Governor General's Innovation Awards program, including program objectives, eligibility criteria, and award categories. It serves as the primary resource for understanding and participating in this prestigious national innovation recognition initiative.

## Key Topics

- Governor General's Innovation Awards
- Canadian innovation
- Innovation recognition
- Award eligibility
- Program objectives
- Canada
- Innovation excellence
